audit_items.proof_trace: The market-level assertion at L837 (`coin.value() == inner.amount() + fee`) enforces exact equality (stronger than >=), after which `coin.split(fee)` leaves the principal coin with exactly `inner.amount()`; the reserve then re-validates via `assert!(coin.value() == amount)` at reserve.move:245. The `FlashLoan` hot potato (no `copy`/`drop`/`store` abilities) ensures it can only be consumed once via `repay_flash_loan`, making partial repayment or abandonment impossible.
